description: NLI 测试集：premise 模拟搜索器生成的来源摘要（2-3 句），hypothesis 模拟另一来源提取的 key_claim。label: entailment / contradiction / neutral。主题取自项目实际跑过的研究问题。

premises.P1: RAG adds recurring costs from context and retrieval, while fine-tuning shifts cost upfront with stable per-query pricing. A domain-specific agriculture benchmark found that fine-tuning improved accuracy from 75% to 81%, and a hybrid of fine-tuning and retrieval reached 86%.
premises.P2: Retrieval-augmented generation lets a model use up-to-date documents at inference time without retraining. Updating the knowledge base only requires re-indexing the new documents, which makes RAG suitable when data changes frequently.
premises.P3: A study on LLM agents reported that grounding answers in retrieved evidence reduced hallucination rates by about 40% compared with closed-book generation. The authors note that retrieval does not eliminate hallucination when the retrieved passages are irrelevant.
premises.P4: Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) has the model draft an answer, plan verification questions, answer them independently, and then produce a revised response. Experiments showed that CoVe decreased hallucinations on list-based questions from Wikidata.
premises.P5: LangGraph persists graph state through checkpointers, saving a snapshot of the state at every super-step. For human-in-the-loop workflows, the interrupt function pauses execution, and the graph can be resumed later from the saved checkpoint with a Command object.
premises.P6: In AutoGen, human-in-the-loop is implemented through a UserProxyAgent whose human_input_mode can be set to ALWAYS, TERMINATE, or NEVER. Conversation history is kept in the agents' message lists rather than in an external checkpoint store.
premises.P7: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), introduced by Anthropic in November 2024, is an open standard for connecting AI assistants to external tools and data sources. MCP uses a client-server architecture in which servers expose tools, resources, and prompts over JSON-RPC.
premises.P8: CrewAI organizes agents into crews with predefined roles and tasks, making it quick to prototype role-based collaboration. LangGraph models workflows as explicit graphs of nodes and edges, which gives finer control over branching, loops, and state but requires more code.
premises.P9: Unlike a conventional chatbot that only produces text replies, an AI agent can plan multi-step tasks, call external tools, and act on the results. Agents typically maintain memory across steps to track progress toward a goal.
premises.P10: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) trains a reward model on human preference comparisons and then optimizes the policy with PPO. Recent methods such as DPO remove the separate reward model by optimizing directly on preference pairs.
premises.P11: Multi-agent systems split a complex task across specialized agents, which can improve quality on long tasks but increases token usage. One evaluation found that a multi-agent research setup used about 15 times more tokens than a single chat interaction.
premises.P12: LoRA fine-tunes large models by freezing the pretrained weights and training small low-rank adapter matrices. This reduces the number of trainable parameters by up to 10,000 times compared with full fine-tuning.
